description: This file defines functions and classes for integrating Triton kernels with PyTorch, including mechanisms to trace, wrap, and register Triton-based operations for use within the PyTorch framework. It handles source inspection, kernel resolution, and custom operator creation.

classes.name: TraceableTritonKernelWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for Triton kernels to enable tracing within PyTorch's JIT and FX systems.

methods.name: get_triton_kernels_for_op
methods.description: Retrieve Triton kernels associated with a specific operation name.

methods.name: get_inner_triton_kernels
methods.description: Inspect a callable to find embedded Triton kernels by source code analysis.

methods.name: triton_op
methods.description: Create a custom PyTorch operator backed by Triton kernels, making it traceable and optimizable.

methods.name: set_wrap_triton_enabled
methods.description: Context manager to enable or disable Triton kernel wrapping for tracing.

methods.name: is_wrap_triton_enabled
methods.description: Check if Triton kernel wrapping is currently enabled.

methods.name: capture_triton
methods.description: Alias for wrap_triton, used to capture Triton kernels into a traceable form.

methods.name: wrap_triton
methods.description: Wrap a Triton kernel into a traceable callable for use with PyTorch's FX and export systems.
